facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 53°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 24 to 32 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: left May 20; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 13 (2024), June 15 (2025)

evidence.name: Mt. Tebo
evidence.detail: left April 20; earlier seasons: May 31 (2023), May 15 (2024), May 15 (2025)

evidence.name: Mount Crag
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 5 (2024), June 9 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: 28.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 54.9 in (2023), 36.2 in (2024), 54.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Mt. Tebo

evidence.name: Mount Crag
evidence.detail: 14.8 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 43.4 in (2023), 22.0 in (2024), 36.7 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 7 and July 13, carried from the melt-out dates at Buckinghorse (4,850 ft) and Mount Crag (3,960 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: melted out May 20, 1,084 ft below the pass; points to May 9 to July 8

evidence.name: Mount Crag
evidence.detail: melted out May 8, 1,974 ft below the pass; points to May 6 to July 18
